items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: before I went to the west coast I was with Buddy Rich, with the small group.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, okay. What prompted the move to the west coast?
I think mostly there seemed to be maybe like a little slump in what was happening. Of course you know before that, before I went to the west coast I was with Buddy Rich, with the small group.
Oh yeah, I wanted to ask you about that.
